Run clock consumes request-start/receipt timestamps; Runtime only retains actual received_at and later calls the separate freshness helper before painting.
Runtime compares source wall age and local receipt age separately. Run combines source monotonic age, full IPC RTT and queue age.
A backward wall adjustment that leaves now>=sample is not invalid; each supplied age below7000ms passes.
